purpose: Positive ranking reference where Scanner finds a valid triangle but a more structurally complete parent geometry is preferred
issues: Scanner triangle is valid and should not be rejected
Scanner selects a somewhat more local representation of the structure
Manual lower boundary begins from the significant low created after the preceding sharp decline
Manual upper boundary begins from a meaningful structural high
Manual geometry better represents the natural origin and full lifetime of the compression
desired_behavior: Keep the Scanner geometry as an acceptable Triangle Compression candidate
Prefer the manual-style geometry when both candidates are available
Reward boundaries originating from meaningful structural extrema
Reward geometries explaining a larger coherent portion of the structure
Do not make Geometry Ranking so strict that acceptable smaller triangles are rejected
Support graded geometry quality rather than only valid or invalid classification
notes: Important positive boundary case. Scanner detection is acceptable; calibration should improve candidate selection without converting this valid signal into a rejection.
